values.note: Booked through the motel front desk, (218) 566-2555, 7 a.m.-11 p.m. Minimum stays on weekends and holidays ('inquire within'); the Sunday-Wednesday rate carries a two-night minimum.

values.note: 50/30/20-amp sites $49.99 Sun-Wed, $69.99 Thu-Sat; primitive (for self-contained rigs) $39.99 Sun-Wed, $45.99 Thu-Sat. Read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://theremermotel.com/ ('RV Site Rates $ 69.99 per night Thursday-Saturday, $ 49.99 per night Sunday-Wednesday'; 'Primitive $ 45.99 - Thursday - Saturday, $ 39.99 - Sunday - Wednesday'; '$10.00 per additional person / $10.00 per vehicle per day'; 'many primitive sites for those who are self-contained'), read 2026-11-11

note: Motel with RV sites in Remer plus its own 114-acre campground half a mile from town, near the Chippewa National Forest; guests share the motel's sauna, hot tub and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Operator page read: 8 RV sites at the motel (6 full hookup 50/30/20) + 16 water/electric + 5 primitive at the 114-acre campground; dump; phone booking; hookup sites $49.99 Sun-Wed / $69.99 Thu-Sat, primitive $39.99-45.99, $10 per extra person. Base now the $39.99 primitive site. OHV events flagged; campground pin question.
flags: Price gate passes on the base: hookup sites $49.99 Sun-Wed (primitive $39.99 for self-contained rigs); Thu-Sat $69.99 is over US$50. Google 5.0 (23 reviews); presence passes on the operator website with phone (218) 566-2555 (stored, confirmed).

OHV side (flag only): the operator hosts 'SXS KINGS / ATV' rides (May 29-30, July 24-25, Oct 3, Oct 24, 2026) and notes the Soo Line North Trail 'for easy access to thousands of miles of Snowmobile and ATV/ UTV trails'. It reads as a general motel campground with an OHV side, not a staging base, but the reviewer decides.

Pin: stored 47.05580,-93.91450 is in Remer town south of Main Street, on the motel block (the motel's 8 RV sites). Google places 'Remer Motel Campground' at 47.06325,-93.91007 (309 W Airport Dr, ~890 m NNE), where imagery shows an open, lightly treed field with a mown track and no visible pads (imagery may predate the 16 hookup sites). Left at the motel, where check-in is; the reviewer may prefer the campground point.
Not waterfront confirmed at both places.
